verdict.rationale: The closest first-party capability is batch evaluation. A task suite groups many tasks so one run executes them all against an agent version, and Suite/Compare modes run that whole set together. General SDK automation in several languages is only a building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions on items (bulk edit, delete, tag or import of tasks, scorers or records), any bulk/batch API endpoints, and hands-on corroboration.
